circuit:
* SKY130 bandgap reference, 1.2 V class, high supply rejection.
* Architecture:
*  - Kuijk-type core: two resistor+PNP branches driven from the regulated
*    node vbgi, sense taps split so the error-amp input common mode sits
*    near 1.0 V (allows an NMOS-input first stage).
*  - Error amp: NMOS diff pair, wide-swing cascoded PMOS mirror load
*    (VDD-referenced for supply rejection), PMOS common-source output
*    stage with Miller compensation.
*  - Self-contained beta-multiplier bias with startup latch.
*  - Transistor-only startup latch kicking the regulated node.
*  - Post RC filter (no DC current) from vbgi to the VBG pin for
*    high-frequency supply rejection.
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ==================== bias: beta multiplier ====================
XMB1 nb  nb  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=32 nf=1
XMB2 pb  nb  nbs  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=128 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* High-PSRR 1.2 V-class bandgap reference, Sky130 (PDK devices only)
*
* Core: Kuijk cell.  Q1 (1x) and Q2A..Q2H (8x) are vertical PNP diodes; the
* amplifier forces VA = VB so that dVEB = VT*ln(8) appears across R0 and
* VBG = VEB1 + (R1/R0)*VT*ln(8).  R0/R1/R2 are the same poly resistor type and
* width, so their ratio - and therefore the PTAT slope - tracks over corners.
*
* Amplifier: folded cascode.  An LVT NMOS input pair keeps the tail alive at
* the 0.55..0.85 V VEB common mode, and folding decouples the output swing
* from that common mode (a telescopic stage runs out of room at cold, where
* VEB is high and the pass gate must sit low).  The PMOS branch is double
* cascoded and the NMOS mirror is cascoded, which sets the DC loop gain and
* hence the low-frequency supply rejection.  The mirror cascode bias VCN is
* deliberately high: with the mirror devices close to their saturation edge
* their output resistance collapses, and with it the loop gain and the DC
* PSRR (that single bias cost ~13 dB of rejection before it was raised).
*
* Supply rejection: the pass PMOS only rejects the supply if its Vsg is
* constant, i.e. if its gate tracks AVDD.  At DC the loop does that (residual
* = 1/loop gain); above the loop bandwidth XCC, tied from AVDD to the gate,
* does it passively while also setting the dominant pole.  The two PMOS
* cascodes keep the AVDD-referenced swing on node G from reaching the input
* pair drains differentially, which would otherwise limit the DC PSRR.
*
* Bias: one monotone resistor-referenced branch (XMREF + XRRA..XRRC).  It has
* a single operating point, so the amplifier is always alive and only the
* bandgap loop itself needs the start-up kick.  VCPF/VCP2 are taps on that
* same string, so all PMOS cascode gates track one another over temperature.
*
* Start-up: XMSUP/XMSUN detect VBGC below an NMOS threshold and XMSUD then
* pulls the pass gate down; once the core is up, SUS collapses to ~1 mV.
*
* Output: RC post-filter to the pin.  VBG is capacitively loaded only, so the
* series resistor costs no DC accuracy but adds ~16 dB of rejection at 1 MHz.
*
* All resistors in the core and output path use the linear res_high_po model;
* res_xhigh_po carries a voltage-coefficient term that turns negative at large
* |V| and lets the DC solver converge on non-physical operating points.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ===================== bandgap core =====================
XQ1  SUB SUB VA  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40
XQ2A SUB SUB VE2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40
XQ2B SUB SUB VE2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Sky130 bandgap voltage reference -- 1.1 V class, high supply rejection
*
* Architecture: current-mode (Banba) core.
*
*   Three matched cascoded PMOS current sources (XCS1..XCS3) all take their
*   gate from the error-amplifier output VGP.  The amplifier regulates two
*   ground-referenced nodes NA and NB to equality, so at DC it is forced to
*   hold the source-gate voltage of the whole PMOS array constant: VGP tracks
*   AVDD one for one and the branch current becomes supply independent.  The
*   cascode gate VCP is likewise generated as a fixed offset below AVDD, so
*   the complete current-source array "floats" on the supply and the only
*   residual supply coupling is the cascoded output conductance of the
*   replica branch that drives VBG.
*
*   VBG = R2 * ( V(NA)/R1 + dVEB/R0 ), a weighted sum of a CTAT term (the
*   PNP emitter voltage across R1) and a PTAT term (dVEB of a 1x/24x PNP
*   pair across R0), so R1/R0 sets the temperature coefficient and R2 sets
*   the output level independently.
*
*   RCA/RCB are equal common-mode level shifters: they cancel exactly in the
*   differential balance but lift the amplifier input common mode ~0.1 V off
*   the PNP emitter voltage, which buys tail headroom at high temperature.
*
* Supply rejection:
*   - DC/low frequency: set by the loop (VGP tracking), by the accuracy of
*     the AVDD-referenced cascode bias VCP, and by the cascoded output
*     resistance of the output branch.  All three PMOS stacks use L = 8 um
*     with ~0.3 V of drain-source margin on the bottom device.
*   - High frequency: XCC ties VGP to AVDD, so above the loop bandwidth the
*     array's Vsg stays constant by capacitive tracking instead of by
*     feedback; XCC also provides the dominant pole.  XCO bypasses VBG.
*
* Start-up and uniqueness of the DC solution:
*   - XMSU/XMDET/XMINJ/XMSC force both PMOS gate rails low while VBG is low.
*   - XRDG bounds the bias-branch currents (and hence VNB/VNC) if the loop is
*     pushed far from its operating point.
*   - XMSK/XRSK derive the cascode-bias branch current from VBG rather than
*     from a mirror of the loop current, so that branch cannot run away.
*   - XMCL1..3 clamp AVDD-VCP.  They sit ~0.25 V/stage below threshold in
*     normal operation and only conduct on a large excursion.
*   Together these remove the high-current false operating point; the DC
*   solution found by an operating-point analysis agrees with a transient
*   power-up over process, supply, temperature and solver tolerance.
*
* Devices are Sky130 PDK subcircuits only: pfet_01v8, pfet_01v8_lvt,
* nfet_01v8, nfet_01v8_lvt, pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40, res_high_po, cap_mim_m3_1.
* Standard-Vt PMOS is used everywhere the gate is driven by VGP so that the
* amplifier output stage keeps headroom at hot/fast corners; low-Vt PMOS is
* used for the cascodes so the 1.7 V supply still clears a 1.12 V output.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Unit cascoded PMOS current source for the reference branches.
.subckt bg_pcs OUTP VGPX VCPX VDDX
XB    NMD  VGPX VDDX VDDX sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=168 nf=28
XC    OUTP VCPX NMD  VDDX sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=168 nf=28
.ends bg_pcs

* Smaller companion cell for the two bias branches, where neither absolute
* accuracy nor output resistance matters.
.subckt bg_pcsb OUTP VGPX VCPX VDDX
XB    NMD  VGPX VDDX VDDX sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=105 nf=15
XC    OUTP VCPX NMD  VDDX sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=36 nf=6
.ends bg_pcsb

.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ------------------------- PMOS current source array -----------------------
XCS1  NA   VGP VCP AVDD bg_pcs
XCS2  NB   VGP VCP AVDD bg_pcs
XCS3  VBG  VGP VCP AVDD bg_pcs
* The bias branches run from a resistively dropped rail.  The drop is only
* ~0.2 V in normal operation but grows steeply if the loop is driven far from
* its operating point, bounding VNB/VNC and every current mirrored from them.
XRDG  NDG  AVDD SUB sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=36.0
XCS4  VNB  VGP VCP NDG bg_pcsb
XCS5  VNC  VGP VCP NDG bg_pcsb

* High-PSRR, curvature-compensated bandgap reference (Sky130 PDK devices only)
*
* Core: an op-amp forced PNP bandgap. Q1 (1x) and Q2 (8x) are vertical PNPs
* (collector = SUB, base = AVSS). The OTA forces V(AT)=V(BT), which is
* equivalent to V(A)=V(B), so I = VT*ln(8)/R1. A cascoded PMOS mirror copies
* this PTAT current into the output branch R2 + Q3 (1x):
*     VBG = VEB3 + (R2/R1)*VT*ln(8)            (about 1.19 V)
*
* Curvature correction: R1 is 12 short high_po segments whose zero-TC contact
* heads make up about half of the resistance, while R2 is one long
* body-dominated high_po resistor. The positive R2/R1 temperature coefficient
* adds a +T^2 term that cancels the VEB curvature. The PDK corner parameters
* scale every high_po resistor the same way, so the ratio does not depend on
* corner.
*
* Supply rejection:
*  - Every mirror device is cascoded. The cascode gate VC = AVDD - I*RS - VSG(MD)
*    is referenced to AVDD, so the mirror devices keep a constant VSD (= I*RS).
*  - R0X+R0Y replicate R2, so all mirror cascode drains (AP, BP, VBG) sit at the
*    same voltage and every branch sees identical VDS.
*  - The OTA load is a replica of the core mirror (same devices, same VC
*    cascodes), so the load diode X tracks the VSG the core mirror needs as
*    AVDD moves. The OTA output VG then follows AVDD with almost no input error.
*  - CC (to AVDD) is the dominant-pole compensation and holds VSG constant at
*    high frequency. COUT shunts supply coupling at VBG; the output branch is
*    outside the feedback loop, so COUT does not affect stability.
*
* Startup: while the core is off, S is low, so the weak pull-up MWK raises K and
* MST/MSTC pull VG and VC low. Once the sense branch MS/MSC conducts, MNK pulls
* K to ground and releases the startup devices.
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ===========================================================================
* High-PSRR 1.2 V-class bandgap voltage reference - SKY130
*
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* TOPOLOGY  (Kuijk reference, sensed at the top of the branches)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
*   Two matched LVT-PMOS sources (MB1/MB2, gate = PGATE) feed two branches:
*
*     branch 1 :  VBG --[ RL = 8 units ]-- NA --| Q1  (1 x substrate PNP)
*     branch 2 :  NY  --[ RL = 8 units ]-- NB --[ R1 = 1 unit ]-- NC --| Q2 (8x)
*
*   The error amplifier forces VBG = NY.  Both PMOS sources then carry the same
*   current, so Q1 and Q2 carry equal emitter currents with an 8:1 area ratio:
*
*        I   = dVBE / R1 = VT*ln(8) / R1
*        VBG = VBE1 + (RL/R1) * VT*ln(8)        (RL/R1 = 8 exactly)
*
*   Sensing the *tops* of the branches (rather than the classic bottom nodes)
*   is what makes this work on a 1.7 V rail: the amplifier common-mode input is
*   the reference itself (~1.20 V), which is an ideal bias for an NMOS input
*   pair, and it puts VBG *inside* the regulation loop so the output enjoys the
*   full loop gain instead of hanging off an out-of-loop mirror leg.
*
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* TEMPERATURE DRIFT
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
*   RL and R1 are built from IDENTICAL res_high_po unit cells (w=1, l=7.1,
*   ~2.7 kOhm) wired in series.  The unit contains a TC-free contact "head" in
*   series with a TC-bearing body; using identical units makes RL/R1 = 8.000 at
*   every temperature and every resistor corner, so only the (ratio-free) PNP
*   physics sets the curve.  Residual drift is the usual VBE curvature: ~24
*   ppm/C over -40..85 C.
*
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* SUPPLY REJECTION
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
*   The closed-loop supply error is  VBG/AVDD = (RL/R1) * (amplifier
*   input-referred supply error), so the amplifier is the whole game.  Its
*   input-referred supply error is  (Gout*kappa - Gm_supply)/Gm_in  where
*   kappa = dPGATE/dAVDD (~1.01, forced by the branch source).  Three things
*   keep it near 25 uV/V:
*     - every PMOS gate reference (PGATE, PCASC) is AVDD-referenced, so the
*       branch/fold source Vsg does not move with the rail;
*     - the folded-cascode output node (which *is* PGATE) is cascoded on both
*       the PMOS and the NMOS side with long channels (l = 4..8 um), which
*       drives both Gout and Gm_supply into the tens-of-nS range;
*     - the tail source MTAI is a long-channel device so the input pair's
*       common-mode current does not track the rail.
*   Result: about -74 dB at 0.01 Hz nominal, -71 dB worst case over the
*   declared PVT set.
*
*   At high frequency the loop is gone and rejection is passive:
*     - CPG (20 pF MIM, PGATE->AVDD) makes the branch gate track AVDD so the
*       source Vsg stays constant, and also sets the loop's dominant pole;
*     - CBG (5 pF MIM, VBG->AVSS) shunts the residual AVDD->VBG displacement
*       current through the branch PMOS drain/gate overlap capacitance.
*   Result: about -44 dB at 1 MHz nominal, -38 dB worst case.
*
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* START-UP
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
*   MSU2 (long, minimum-width PMOS) weakly pulls ST high whenever VBG is low.
*   ST turns on MSU1, which pulls PGATE down and forces current into the
*   branches, so the zero-current state is not a valid DC solution at all.
*   Once VBG is up, MSU3 clamps ST to a few mV and MSU1 leaks < 0.1 pA, so the
*   start-up cell does not load the regulated node in steady state.
* ===========================================================================
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* 1.2 V class bandgap reference in Sky130 PDK devices.
*
*  Core    : Kuijk style "VBE + K*dVBE" current-mode core.  A 1:1 PMOS
*            mirror feeds three branches, and every branch carries a
*            matched resistor R2 from the mirror drain down to a diode
*            node, so all three mirror devices work at the same Vds and
*            their output conductances track.  That matters: the supply
*            rejection of a mirror-loaded reference is set by the gds
*            mismatch between branches (the loop can only null the common
*            current error), and an unmatched output branch costs tens of
*            dB of low frequency PSRR.
*            Node A (1x PNP) receives the branch-A current plus the
*            output-branch current, node B (8x PNP) receives one branch
*            current through R1, so I*R1 = VBE1(2I) - VBE2(I) =
*            VT*ln(16) and VBG = VBE1 + (R2/R1)*VT*ln(16).  The amplifier
*            senses the tops of two matched R2 resistors, which sit at the
*            output level, so the input common mode is one VBE plus one
*            I*R2.  Only ratios of like poly resistors set the output, so
*            the resistor temperature coefficient cancels to first order.
*            A Banba (shunt divider) core was rejected because it also
*            admits a degenerate "diodes starved" DC solution.
*
*  Amplifier: two stage.  NMOS lvt differential pair, PMOS lvt mirror load,
*            PMOS common-source second stage biased from the first stage
*            mirror node, Miller compensated with a MIM cap.  The tail and
*            the second stage sink are mirrored from a resistor-fed NMOS
*            diode, so the amplifier stays alive even when the reference
*            mirror is off - that is what makes the zero-current state
*            unreachable.
*
*  Startup : the sense stack (XMS over the diode XMDS) trips at roughly two
*            threshold voltages, which is above the dead-state diode voltage
*            but well below the 1.2 V reference, so a starved core is always
*            detected and the mirror gate is pulled low until it starts.
* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* INP: VA>VB -> PG down -> I up -> error down (negative feedback).
XOPA AVDD AVSS VA VB PG bg_opa

* --- Output filtering for high-frequency PSRR (8 pF MIM)
XCOUT VBG AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=63.2 l=63.2

* --- Startup: MIM cap couples the AVDD ramp to SGATE; MSTART pulls PG low.
* A 1 M poly resistor discharges SGATE (tau = 10 us) so the pulldown is off
* in steady state; zero static current.
XCST AVDD SGATE sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=71 l=71
XRST SGATE AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=472
XMST PG SGATE AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=4 nf=2

.ends bandgap

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Two-stage NMOS-input opamp: diff pair with poly-resistor tail,
* PMOS mirror load, NMOS common-source second stage, Miller
* compensation with physical nulling resistor.
.subckt bg_opa VDD VSS INP INM VOUT
* Differential pair
XMN1 D1 INP VS VS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=6 nf=2
XMN2 D2 INM VS VS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=6 nf=2
* PMOS active load mirror
XMPL1 D1 D1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=4 nf=2
XMPL2 D2 D1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=4 nf=2
* Fixed tail current source (~1 uA). A resistor tail current grows with
* input common-mode and would shift the balanced output low, opening a
* second high-current equilibrium; the current-source tail prevents it.
XMNT VS NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=6 nf=2
* Independent bias branch: ~1.15 M poly resistor from VDD feeds a diode
* NMOS (NB); the fixed diode voltage biases the tail.
XRB VDD NB VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=543
XMNB NB NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=6 nf=2
* Second stage: NMOS CS with PMOS load mirrored 4x from the first-stage diode
XMN6 VOUT D2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=2 nf=2
XMP6 VOUT D1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.01 w=16 nf=4
* Miller compensation (~1.2 pF) with ~1 k nulling resistor
XRZ D2 CZP VSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=0.46
XCC CZP VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=24.5 l=24.5
.ends bg_opa

* High-PSRR 1.2 V-class bandgap reference (Sky130).
* Kuijk-style core: the opamp forces the two regulator-PMOS drain
* nodes (VBG and NB) equal.  Branch A carries Rptat + unit PNP Q1;
* branch B carries R3 (R3=Rptat+Rdelta) + 8x PNP Q2:
*   VBE1+I*Rptat = VBE2+I*R3
*   I*(Rdelta) = VBE1-VBE2 ~ VT*ln(8)
*   VBG = VBE1 + (Rptat/Rdelta)*~VT*ln(8).
* VBG is the regulated node itself (inside the feedback loop).
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ---- Regulator pass PMOS (long L: high ro / good channel rejection) ----
XMP1 AVDD PGATE VBG AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMP2 AVDD PGATE NB  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4

* ---- Bandgap branches ----
* Branch A: Rptat VBG->VE1, Q1 unit substrate PNP
XRPA1 VBG NRP1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5.58
XRPA2 NRP1 VE1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=5.58
XQ1 AVSS AVSS VE1 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
* Branch B: R3 NB->VE2, Q2 = 8x unit PNP
XRB1 NB NRB1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=6.85
XRB2 NRB1 VE2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=6.85
XQ2 AVSS AVSS VE2 pnp8

* ---- Bias generator (bootstrapped from core gate PGATE) ----
XMPB AVDD PGATE NBIAS AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMNB NBIAS NBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1
* PMOS current-source bias PBIAS: diode PMOS stacked on NBIAS-referenced NMOS
XMPD AVDD PBIAS PBIAS AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMND PBIAS NBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ---- Error amplifier, stage 1: LVT NMOS diff pair, long-L PMOS load ----
XMN3 N1 VBG NS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2
XMN4 N2 NB  NS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2
XMNT NS NBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=8
XMP3 N1 N1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2
XMP4 N2 N1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=2

* ---- Error amplifier, stage 2: LVT NMOS CS, long-L PMOS current load ----
XMN5 PGATE N1 AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4
XMP5 PGATE PBIAS AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8

* ---- Miller compensation ----
XCC N1 PGATE sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=25
* Output bypass / high-frequency filtering
XCOUT VBG AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=32 l=32

* ---- Startup (self-disconnecting once NB rises) ----
* MS1 weak pull-up diode to ST; MS2 kicks PGATE down;
* MS3 pulls ST to ground when the core is running.
XMS1 AVDD AVDD ST   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=0.5
XMS2 PGATE ST   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2
XMS3 ST   NB   AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4

.ends bandgap

* Eight parallel unit substrate PNPs (real emitter-area ratio 8:1).
.subckt pnp8 C B E
XQ21 C B E sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
XQ22 C B E sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
XQ23 C B E sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68

XQ27 C B E sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
XQ28 C B E sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
.ends pnp8

* =====================================================================
* High-PSRR 1.2 V bandgap reference, Sky130.
* Current-mode (Brokaw-style) core:
*   - Three matched PMOS current sources (MP1/MP2/MP3) set equal leg
*     currents from the common gate bias GA.
*   - Leg 1: diode pnp Q1 (1x).  Leg 2: R1 + 8x parallel pnp Q2.
*     Amplifier forces V(P1)=V(P2), so I*R1 = Vbe1-Vbe2 = Vt*ln(8):
*     the leg current is PTAT.
*   - Leg 3 (output): R2 + 1x pnp Q3, giving VBG = Vbe + I*R2, a
*     temperature-compensated ~1.2 V.
*   - Two-stage amplifier (5-transistor OTA + common-source gain stage)
*     gives high DC loop gain for low-frequency supply rejection.
*   - MIM capacitor AVDD-GA makes the PMOS gates track the supply at
*     high frequency, so leg currents (and VBG) reject supply ripple
*     above the loop bandwidth.
*   - Startup circuit pulls GA low when the core is off and disconnects
*     once the core is running.
* All passives are physical Sky130 PDK devices (res_high_po, cap_mim_m3_1).
* =====================================================================
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ---- Core PMOS current sources (pfet_01v8, long L for high ro) ----
XMP1  AVDD GA  P1  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40  l=20  nf=8
XMP2  AVDD GA  P2  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40  l=20  nf=8
XMP3  AVDD GA  VBG AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40  l=20  nf=8

* ---- Core resistors (physical high-sheet poly) ----
* R1: PTAT delta-Vbe resistor (leg 2).  ~10.8k target at 5 uA.
XR1  P2  A2  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=33
* R2: output CTAT/PTAT sum resistor.  ~104k target.
XR2  VBG X3  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=212

* ---- BJT diodes: pnp_05v5, base+collector(substrate) to AVSS ----
XQ1    AVSS AVSS P1 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2A   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2B   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2C   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2D   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2E   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2F   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2G   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2H   AVSS AVSS A2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ3    AVSS AVSS X3 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68

* ---- Amplifier stage 1: 5-transistor OTA ----
* NMOS input pair.  P1 -> diode-mirror drain D5 (-), P2 -> GA1 (+).
XN5  D5  P1  TN  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=8 nf=1
XN6  GA1 P2  TN  AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=8 nf=1
* PMOS current-mirror load (long L for high ro / gain)
XP7  D5  D5  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=8 nf=1
XP8  GA1 D5  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=8 nf=1
* Tail current source (2x mirror of diode N12)
XN4  TN  NB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=8 nf=2

* ---- Amplifier stage 2: PMOS common-source gain stage, drives GA ----
XP9  GA  GA1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=8 nf=4
* NMOS active load (2x mirror of diode N12)
XN10 GA  NB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=8 nf=2

* ---- Amplifier bias: P13 (gate GA, mirrors core leg current) feeds
* diode N12, which biases tail N4 and stage-2 load N10.
XP13 NB  GA  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=10 nf=2
XN12 NB  NB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=8 nf=1

* ---- Startup circuit ----
* Zero state: P1 low, GA low -> MS0 pulls S1 high -> MS3 pulls GA low
* (turns core PMOS on hard).  Running: P1 ~0.75 V turns LVT MS1 on,
* MS0 off -> S1 low -> MS3 off.
XPS0 S1  GA  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      w=0.5 l=2   nf=1
XPS1 S1  P1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  w=4   l=0.5 nf=2
XPS3 GA  S1  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      w=1   l=2   nf=1

* ---- Compensation (physical MIM + poly) ----
* Miller compensation around stage 2 with nulling resistor
XRZ  GA1 CCP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=100
XCC  CCP GA       sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=40 l=40
* Supply-tracking cap: holds GA at fixed Vsg from AVDD at high frequency
XCG  AVDD GA      sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=35 l=35
* Output decoupling: filters leg-3 supply feedthrough (outside loop)
XCL  VBG AVSS     sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=63 l=63

.ends bandgap

XQ1  E1  AVSS AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68

XM2  VB  VOP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   w=4 l=1 nf=2
XRR2 VB  E2  SUB    sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po  w=1 l=142
XRR3 E2  D2  SUB    sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po  w=1 l=13
XQ2a D2 AVSS AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
XQ2b D2 AVSS AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68

XQ2g D2 AVSS AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
XQ2h D2 AVSS AVSS  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68

* ---- Bias generation: mirror bandgap current (via VOP) into NMOS diode VBN ----
XMBN VBN VOP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8   w=4 l=1 nf=2
XMNB VBN VBN AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   w=4 l=1 nf=2
XCB  VBN AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=20 mult=4

XM5  P1  VBG TAIL AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  w=4 l=1 nf=2

circuit:
* High-PSRR Widlar/Brokaw-style bandgap reference in Sky130.
* Pins: AVDD supply, AVSS ground, VBG ~1.2 V output, SUB substrate.
*
* Core: matched PMOS current sources (gate GCP) with PMOS cascodes
* (gate GCAS) feed two branches:  VBG - R3 - Q1(1x)  and
* N2 - R2 - Q2(8x parallel).  All BJTs are diode PNP with base and
* collector at AVSS.  An NMOS-input OTA forces VBG = N2, so
* I*(R2-R3) = dVbe (PTAT) and VBG = Vbe + I*R3 ~ 1.2 V.  VBG is the
* cascode drain of branch 1 and is the output node.
*
* The OTA inputs sit at ~1.2 V; regular-threshold input FETs keep the
* tail-source node low enough for a ground-referenced diode bias.
* Cascode gates are biased from a diode PMOS hung from the quiet VBG
* node into an NBIAS-referenced NMOS sink, so GCAS inherits VBG's
* supply rejection.  A startup inverter on VBG drives an NMOS clamp
* that pulls GCP low at power-up and releases once VBG is established.

.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* --- Core current sources (long channel for high ro) ---
XMP1A NA   GCP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=8
XMP2A NBR  GCP AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=8
* --- Cascode devices (gates at GCAS, drain of branch 1 is VBG) ---
XMPC1 VBG GCAS NA  AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=8
XMPC2 N2  GCAS NBR AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=8

* --- Bandgap branches: emitter resistor then diode PNP ---
XR3 VBG E1 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=27.0
XQ1 AVSS AVSS E1 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XR2 N2  E2 AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=28.6
XQ2A AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2B AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2C AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2D AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2E AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2F AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2G AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68
XQ2H AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68

* --- OTA tail bias: PMOS (mirror of core) feeds a long diode NMOS
*     so NBIAS is high enough to drive the tail with its source
*     up at the input common mode ---
XMPB NBIAS GCP  AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4  nf=1
XMNB NBIAS NBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=1  nf=1

* --- Cascode gate bias: quiet diode PMOS from VBG into NMOS sink ---
XMPD GCAS GCAS VBG  VBG  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=2 nf=1
XMND GCAS NBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8   l=8   w=1 nf=1

* --- NMOS-input 5-transistor OTA; output is GCP ---
XMN1 ND1 N2  NT   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 GCP VBG NT   AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMNT NT  NBIAS AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
XMP3 ND1 ND1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMP4 GCP ND1 AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

XCC GCP AVSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=30 l=30 mult=1

XMSU1 ST  VBG AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=4
XMSU2 ST  VBG AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2  nf=1

* High-PSRR bandgap reference (Sky130).
* Kuijk core with op-amp regulation, supply-independent bias
* bootstrapped from the regulated output, and self-shutoff startup.
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Bandgap core (Kuijk).
*   Q1 (1x) emitter = VA ; Q2 (8x) emitter = VC ; R1 between VB and VC.
*   Two equal R2 from VBG to VA and VBG to VB force equal branch currents.
*   Op-amp forces VA = VB  ->  I = dVbe/R1 = Vt*ln(8)/R1 (PTAT),
*   VBG = Vbe1 + I*R2.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XQ1  AVSS AVSS VA  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68 mult=1
XQ2  AVSS AVSS VC  sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68 mult=8
XR1  VB VC AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=28
XR2A VBG VA AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=320
XR2B VBG VB AVSS sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=320

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Op-amp: PMOS diff pair + NMOS mirror load + NMOS CS output stage
*   with PMOS current-source load. Inputs: + = VA, - = VB, OUT = VBG.
*   PB = bias gate (PMOS current sources).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
XM0 NTAIL PB   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=5
XM1 NDA   VA   NTAIL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=5
XM2 NDB   VB   NTAIL AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=5
XM3 NDA   NDA  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=2 nf=5
XM4 NDB   NDA  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=2 nf=5
XM5 VBG   NDB  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=5
XM6 VBG   PB   AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=5

* Miller compensation (stage-1 output NDB -> output VBG)
XCC NDB VBG sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10

* ---------------------------------------------------------------

* High-PSRR CMOS bandgap reference (Sky130)
* Public interface: AVDD AVSS VBG SUB
*
* Banba-style core, sense resistor on the LARGE BJT branch:
*   Branch 1: Q1(1x)       -> n1 = VBE1
*   Branch 2: R2 + Q2(5x)  -> n2 = I*R2 + VBE2
*   Branch 3: R3 + Q3(1x)  -> VBG = I*R3 + VBE3
* Amp forces n1 = n2  =>  I = dVBE/R2 (PTAT).
* VBG = VBE3 + (R3/R2)*dVBE, first-order temperature compensated.
*
* Supply rejection: n1=n2 matches the PMOS drain voltages so the
* mirror current is supply-insensitive; high loop gain holds I; a
* large MIM on the mirror gate freezes the core current at HF.

.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* Supply-independent Iref.  A VBG-gated NMOS with R in its source
* sets I = f(VBG,R); the PMOS diode at its drain is the nbiasp
* mirror.  I does not depend on AVDD and VBG is not loaded (gate).
* Startup PMOS (gate=VBG, |Vth|=0.95V) feeds nbiasp until VBG>0.85V.

XMB    nbias nbias  AVSS AVSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

* Startup: nst high before regulation pulls the mirror gate low;

* Sky130 high-PSRR bandgap reference
* .subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB
*
* Kuijk-style PNP core (1x / 8x / 1x):
*   Branch 1: n1 = Vbe
*   Branch 2: n2 = I*R2 + Vbe2
*   Branch 3: VBG = I*R3 + Vbe3
* OTA1 forces n1 = n2  =>  I = Vt*ln(8)/R2
*   VBG = Vbe + I*R3 = Vbe + (R3/R2)*Vt*ln(8)
* R2 is one unit resistor and R3 is nine identical units in series,
* so R3/R2 = 9 even with head resistance.
* K = 9*ln(8) = 18.71 cancels the measured Vbe tempco
* (dVbe/dT ~ -1.59 mV/C at PTAT current, dVt/dT = 86 uV/C).
*
* Current sources: PMOS driver (source = AVDD so Vsg = AVDD - vbias)
* plus PMOS cascode for output resistance. vbias is the mirror diode
* node, so Vsg_mirror tracks the diode and does not move with AVDD
* when the diode current is supply-independent. A constant-gm bias
* provides that supply-independent current for the OTA loads.

.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* ===================== constant-gm bias ==========================
* Self-biased PMOS/NMOS pair with a resistor sets a current that is
* independent of AVDD. Long L keeps ro high so the current does not
* move with AVDD. vbias_p = AVDD - Vsg tracks AVDD 1:1, which keeps
* XMPL/XMTAIL Vsg constant for high PSRR.

XMNB vbias_n vbias_n SUB   SUB   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* vbias_rb is a PMOS diode whose current comes from the constant-gm,

* ncas = vbias_rb + Vsg_cas also tracks AVDD, holding Vsd_drv
* constant so the driver current does not move with the supply.

* High-PSRR bandgap reference, sky130 (continuous model set), ~1.1 V output.
* Core: Brokaw cell on substrate PNPs. Q1 1x, Q2 8x with R2 set the PTAT
* branch current I = VT*ln(8)/R2; output branch Q3/R1 gives
* VBG = VEB + (R1/R2)*VT*ln(8).
* PSRR architecture:
*  - Sense nodes VXN/VYN are lifted to the output voltage by shift
*    resistors RS1/RS2 that are exact copies of R1. Then all three mirror
*    drains sit at (nearly) the same potential VBG at every PVT point, so
*    the mirror gds supply feedthrough is identical in all branches and the
*    loop rejects it. The shift drops cancel in the loop equation
*    VEB1 = VEB2 + I*R2, so the PTAT relation is unchanged.
*  - NMOS-input error amplifier (sense common mode ~ VBG ~ 1.2 V) with a
*    resistive tail; the NA/VBPB bias rails come from a mirror copy
*    (M4/MNA) plus MNB/MBP.
*  - Output stage as in the proven PMOS-input version: N5 (gate C1) pulls G
*    down, P6 (gate VBPB) pulls G up. This breaks the high-current latch
*    (large current -> C1 low -> N5 off -> G up -> mirror off).
*  - Startup: in the zero state P6 (VBPB=0) holds G at AVDD (mirror off).
*    XRST injects current into the NA diode; once VBPB rises, P6 weakens
*    and XNPU (gate NA) pulls G down to ignite the mirror. CG freezes the
*    mirror Vsg at HF; CF shunts HF feedthrough.
* NOTE: in this model set pfet_01v8 (non-lvt) has |Vth| ~ 1 V and is not
* usable at 1.7-1.9 V supplies; all PMOS devices use pfet_01v8_lvt.
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB

* Branch 1: shift resistor (R1 copy) lifts the sense node to ~VBG.
XRS1 VXN E1 SUB sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=251.7
XQ1 AVSS AVSS E1 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68
* Branch 2: R2 sets the PTAT current; RS2 (R1 copy) lifts the sense node.
XR2 VYN B2 SUB sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=32.8
XRS2 B2 E2 SUB sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=251.7
XQ2 AVSS AVSS E2 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68 m=8
* Branch 3: output branch; VBG = I*R1 + VEB(Q3).
XR1 VBG E3 SUB sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=251.7
XQ3 AVSS AVSS E3 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_w0p68l0p68

** ---- PMOS-lvt branch mirror ----------------------------------------
XMP1 VXN G AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMP2 VYN G AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=10 nf=2
XMP3 VBG G AVDD AVDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=10 nf=2
* Mirror gate bypass to AVDD keeps Vsg constant at HF.
XCG G AVDD sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50

* NMOS diodes; cascode gates sit on VBPB so leg currents are supply clean.

XMNA NA NA AVSS SUB sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* Bandgap reference for sky130 (1.2 V class output).
*
* Topology: single-loop regulated bandgap. The opamp output GP drives pass
* PMOS XPOUT which sources the VBG node. The feedback network derives two
* currents from VBG itself:
*   path A: VBG -RA- X -R2- Q1 (8x substrate PNP diode) - AVSS
*   path B: VBG -RB- Y - Q2 (1x substrate PNP diode) - AVSS
* The opamp forces X = Y; with RA = RB the two path currents are equal (I)
* and I*R2 = dVeb = Vt*ln(8), so I is PTAT and
*   VBG = Veb2 + (RB/R2)*Vt*ln(8) ~ 1.2 V.
* Because VBG is inside the loop, low-frequency PSRR is set by the loop gain.
*
* Supply feed enters through Rf/Cf (VDDI), which attenuates HF supply noise.
* Bias: diode XMNB fed by XRB1 from VDDI; the tail (XMT), second stage
* (XMN5) and shunt load (XNOUT) are current-mirror copies of XMNB so their
* currents track corner/temperature instead of relying on absolute Vgs.
* An inverter-driven bleed device XMST pulls GP low while VBG is still near
* 0 so the reference cannot latch in the dead state (power-up/startup).
.subckt bandgap AVDD AVSS VBG SUB
